title: Rabbi Yochanan M’lachashekh
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Eruvin 91a reads, “Rabbi Yochanan likewise said: Who whispered to you?”
Tosafot there records a reading of M'lachashekh as one word, explaining that it refers to the unqualified Rabbi Yochanan because his birth was associated with a whisper, as in Yoma 82b.

notes.text: The Yoma paragraph describes a whisper to the pregnant mother, after which Yochanan was born. “Born from a whisper” was misleadingly literal; the epithet and two-word question remain alternative readings.
